scope: New registry/proposals/ entry (registry/proposals/flood_outlet_coping.json, PROP-FLOOD-06): one method-domain (M) proposal for a community flood-readout application (FloodConnect), via the governed proposals-lane intake process -- NOT promoted into registry/CANONICAL.json, which requires the full schema/lineage/checker workflow this entry has not gone through. PROP-FLOOD-06 is an area-generic outlet-headroom/drainage-coping indicator for a declared drainage unit U (village/district/province/sub-basin, tuple <A_U,O_U,P_U,c_U>): outlet headroom R_H(U) (sum over declared outlets of max(0,Q_cap,o-Q_o,now)*H*3600), drainage-clearable volume D_H(U) (running pumps * horizon * a declared gravity/tide derating factor, 0 when no pumps declared), forecast inflow F_H(U) (rainfall-runoff plus declared upstream-mainstem inflow), the severity ratio S_H(U)=F_H/min(D_H,R_H), and a new urgency readout T_act(U) (time-to-exhaustion, a direct PROP-FLOOD-02 time-to-threshold instantiation with a time-varying threshold). These two are combined into a declared >=5-level tier ladder (L0..L4 numeric bands over S_H/T_act, explicitly marked OPEN-for-founder-tuning; L5 a separate pre-check for already-exhausted/overtopped units; LR REFUSED always dominant), plus a unit-resolution step that lets U be derived from any (lat,lon) in Thailand by walking the basin/water/pump/gauge graph, with every resolved input tagged VERIFIED/RELAYED/INSTINCT and REFUSED (not degraded) on an unresolved required input. New refusal codes: UNIT_NOT_DECLARED, UNIT_POLYGON_MISSING, OUTLET_CAPACITY_UNKNOWN, NO_GAUGE_IN_UNIT, ZERO_CAPACITY_NONZERO_INFLOW (NO_PUMPS_IN_UNIT is declared explicitly not a refusal). Cites delta_R (instance_of), PROP-FLOOD-03 (reuses, for the F_H rainfall-runoff term and refusal-code discipline), PROP-FLOOD-02 (instance_of, for T_act), PROP-FLOOD-05 (generalises, for the binding(U)/binding(o) boolean readout), and EQ-001/C.01.v1 (generalises, via PROP-FLOOD-03), all quoted/cited, not restated as new theorems. It is tier Dr / status unverified, carries an explicit claim_boundary/honest_caveats disclaiming any hydraulic/hydrological simulation content and flagging every declared constant/threshold (Q_cap,o, c_U, g_U(t), the tier-ladder thresholds) as DECLARED/RELAYED/INSTINCT/OPEN as appropriate, and empirical_test_status is 'none'. A new Coq stub (coq/canonical/PROP_FLOOD_06_outlet_coping_tier.v) formalises only the pure numeric tier-ladder function over Q as total and decidable (Print Assumptions: Closed under the global context, no axioms) -- it does not formalise the refusal precedence, the graph-based unit resolution, or the L5 pre-check, which remain OPEN. No claim about the Clay Millennium Navier-Stokes problem, or about any object's Clay/NS status, is made or implied anywhere in this change; the status of every existing Clay-related registry object (CANONICAL.json, coq/canonical/ pre-existing files, docs/CLAY_*) is unchanged -- this PR adds one new proposals-lane JSON file, one new Coq stub file, and one new docs/proposals/ markdown file only.
